question:
A 46-year-old male presents with acute onset of low back pain that started when he was trying to lift a
heavy box while helping his brother move apartments two days ago. The pain has been severe enough
to cause him to miss work yesterday. He has no neurologic deficits. What are the chances he will
return to work within 6 weeks? Answer Choices: (A) 60 to 70% (B) 80 to 90% (C) 55 to 65% (D) 90 to
100% (E) 65 to 75% (F) 70 to 80% (G) 40 to 50% (H) 50 to 60% (I) 85 to 95% (J) 75 to 85%

A. 75 to 85%
B. 85 to 95%
C. 50 to 60%
D. 60 to 70%
E. 55 to 65%
F. 65 to 75%
G. 70 to 80%
H. 40 to 50%
I. 90 to 100%
J. 80 to 90%
